messages.author: 3e4d6d7a2135dc18
messages.subject: Mediation model with multiple variables
parts:
Hi all, I am new to using lavaan and R. I can't get my mediation model to work for the life of me, and tried lots of different things and played around quite a lot to go through trial and and error. I have two predictors (narcissism and psychopathy), a mediator (bullying), and two outcomes (mental health and counterproductive work behaviour). I keep getting this error: 

Error in lavaan::lavaan(model = mediation_model, data = LMRS, se = "boostrap",  : 
  lavaan ERROR: missing observed variables in dataset: Counterproductive_Work_Behaviour Mental_Health Bullying

I have popped my syntax below, can anyone notice any obvious errors? I understand the standard mediation syntax on the lavaan tutorial website, but can't work out how to a) correctly write the syntax for more variables beyond a simple mediation and b) why my exogenous variables in particular are being noted as missing.

#FACTOR SPECIFICATION
Narcissism = ' narc =~ Narc_1 + Narc_2 + Narc_3 + Narc_4 + Narc_5 '
                   
Conduct_Problems = ' con_prob =~ Con_Prob_1 + Con_Prob_2 + Con_Prob_3 + Con_Prob_4 '

Callousness = ' cal =~ Cal_1 + Cal_2 + Cal_3 + Cal_4 '

Manipulativeness = ' man =~ Man_1 + Man_2 + Man_3 + Man_4 '

Impetuousness = ' imp =~ Imp_1 + Imp_2 + Imp_3 + Imp_4 + Imp_5 + Imp_6 + Imp_7 + Imp_8 '

Counterproductive_Work_Behaviour = ' cwb =~ CWB_1 + CWB_2 + CWB_3 + CWB_4 + CWB_5 + CWB_6 + CWB_7 + CWB_8 + CWB_9 '

General_Mental_Health = ' gmh =~ GMH_1 + GMH_2 + GMH_3 + GMH_4 + GMH_5 + GMH_6 '

Depression = ' dep =~ Dep_1 + Dep_2 + Dep_3 + Dep_4 + Dep_5 + Dep_6 '

Bullying = ' bul =~ Bul_1 + Bul_2 + Bul_3 + Bul_4 + Bul_5 + Bul_6 + Bul_7 + Bul_8 + Bul_9 + 
  Bul_10 + Bul_11 + Bul_12 + Bul_13 + Bul_14 + Bul_15 + Bul_16 + Bul_17 + Bul_18 + 
  Bul_19 + Bul_20 + Bul_21 '

#CHECK EACH FACTOR SOLUTION
Narcissism_Fit = cfa(Narcissism, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Narcissism_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Narcissism_Fit)

Conduct_Problems_Fit = cfa(Conduct_Problems, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Conduct_Problems_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Conduct_Problems_Fit)

Callousness_Fit = cfa(Callousness, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Callousness_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Callousness_Fit)

Manipulativeness_Fit = cfa(Manipulativeness, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Manipulativeness_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Manipulativeness_Fit)

Impetuousness_Fit = cfa(Impetuousness, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Impetuousness_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Impetuousness_Fit)

Counterproductive_Work_Behaviour_Fit = cfa(Counterproductive_Work_Behaviour, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Counterproductive_Work_Behaviour_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Counterproductive_Work_Behaviour_Fit)

General_Mental_Health_Fit = cfa(General_Mental_Health, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(General_Mental_Health_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(General_Mental_Health_Fit)

Depression_Fit = cfa(Depression, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Depression_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Depression_Fit)

Bullying_Fit = cfa(Bullying, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Bullying_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Bullying_Fit)

#CREATE SECOND ORDER FACTORS
Psychopathy =  ' 
  con_prob =~ Con_Prob_1 + Con_Prob_2 + Con_Prob_3 + Con_Prob_4 
  cal =~ Cal_1 + Cal_2 + Cal_3 + Cal_4 
  man =~ Man_1 + Man_2 + Man_3 + Man_4
  imp =~ Imp_1 + Imp_2 + Imp_3 + Imp_4 + Imp_5 + Imp_6 + Imp_7 + Imp_8 
  psych =~ con_prob + cal + imp + man '

Psychopathy_Fit = cfa(Psychopathy, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Psychopathy_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Psychopathy_Fit)

Mental_Health = '
  dep =~ Dep_1 + Dep_2 + Dep_3 + Dep_4 + Dep_5 + Dep_6
  gmh =~ GMH_1 + GMH_2 + GMH_3 + GMH_4 + GMH_5 + GMH_6
  mh =~ dep + gmh '
Mental_Health_Fit = cfa(Mental_Health, LMRS, ordered = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV")
summary(Mental_Health_Fit, fit.measures = TRUE, rsq = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
standardizedsolution(Mental_Health_Fit)

#MEDIATION MODEL 
mediation_model = 
'
Counterproductive_Work_Behaviour ~ c1 * Narcissism
Counterproductive_Work_Behaviour ~ c2 * Psychopathy
Mental_Health ~ c3 * Narcissism
Mental_Health ~ c4 * Psychopathy

Bullying ~ a1 * Narcissism
Bullying ~ a2 * Psychopathy
Counterproductive_Work_Behaviour ~ b1 * Bullying
Mental_Health ~ b2 * Bullying

ab1 := a1 * b1
ab2 := a2 * b1
ab3 := a1 * b2
ab4 := a2 * b2

total1 := c1 + (a1 * b1)
total2 := c2 + (a1 * b2)
total3 := c3 + (a2 * b1)
total4 := c4 + (a2 * b2)
'

mediation_model_fit = sem(mediation_model, LMRS, se = "boostrap")

Thanks in advance,

Callum

Callum D Mogridge BSc (Hons), AFHEA, MBPsS, MABP

messages.author: 12fdd832cacb825e
messages.subject: Re: Mediation model with multiple variables
parts:
Callum,

Your sem() call to create mediation_model_fit is for data=LMRS. Your factors are latent and are not part of the LMRS dataset, so sem() can't find them. You need to define the factors in the same model as you specify the structural (i.e., '~') relations.

Pat
